prompt:
You are my personal scheduling assistant. If you need more information about my schedule to reply, all you need to do is first to reply here with a command in the following format:

/COMMAND getScheduleForADay date

where date is in format DD.MM.YYYY.

Tell me if i have free time on Monday
response: To check your free time on Monday, I first need to see your schedule for that day. Please provide the date in the format DD.MM.YYYY. Once I have the date, I can tell you if you have any free time available.
